Affected.description: A record reached through incoming relations.

depth.description: 1 for a direct relation to the subject.

via.description:
The edge it was first reached by: `via.to` is the subject or an
affected record nearer to it.

Document.description: A document that holds or names the subject or an affected record.

id.description: A Warrant's alias, a ticket's id, or a record atom's path.

Evaluation.description: An obligation's verdict on an affected record.

reads.description:
`current` (bound to this revision), `stale` (bound to another) or
`unbound` (pins none).

verdict.description: The disposition as the corpus reads it now, if it has one.

Phase.description: A roadmap phase whose progress an affected Warrant feeds.

achieved.description: Its achievement as the corpus derives it now.

via.description: The affected Warrants placed in it.

Projection.description: A generated view known to include an affected Warrant or phase.

scope.description:
`warrant` (that Warrant's own view), `corpus` (every Warrant's) or
`roadmap` (every phase's). M6 adds declared projection targets.

kind.description:
`part_of`, `parent`, `supersedes`, `roadmap`, `implements`,
`depends_on` or `promoted_to`; from authored relations (OW-WAR-0148
M3), any core kind or a namespaced one (`x.mentions`), which is
carried and drives nothing.

to_revision.description:
The revision of `to` the relation pins (`REQ-pr1@sha256:…`), when it
pins one. A pin that is not `to`'s revision now reads stale.

description: What a change to one record affects.

basis_digest.description: The model's `basis_digest` this was read from.

inert.description:
Namespaced relations into the subject or an affected record: carried,
never walked. Sorted.

title: Impact
